title: Vivumishi vya Sifa (Theme 1: Viungo vya mwili vya ndani)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 6 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child finds the noun, then gives the adjective of quality the prefix of the noun's class (moyo mzuri, mapafu mazuri).
steps: Add the class prefix to the adjective.
Put the adjective after the noun.
contexts: internal organs (viungo vya mwili vya ndani)

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child writes "mapafu masafi" and "moyo safi".

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Wanafunzi ___ walipata zawadi." Kwa nini "mzuri" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Kivumishi cha sifa hubadilika kulingana na idadi ya nomino. Wanafunzi wengi, kwa hiyo wazuri.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Kitabu ___ kiko mezani." Kwa nini "mkubwa" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Kivumishi huchukua kiambishi kinacholingana na ngeli ya nomino, kama kitabu kikubwa.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Mkulima ___ alipanda mahindi mengi." Kwa nini "ukarimu" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Kivumishi cha sifa huelezea nomino. Ukarimu ni jina la tabia, si kivumishi.

misconceptions.ask: Neno lipi ni jina, na linakaa wapi?

checks.question: Ni kivumishi cha sifa kipi: "Ana moyo mkubwa."
